reviews.review: What to say about this mediocre experience. For a game like this you need a variety of enemy types and punchy memorable weapons but this game has neither. the worst offender is the grenades, you throw them they go pfft and people fall down out of pity laugh at you call you a ♥♥♥♥♥ and get back up with nought but a scratch. But the saving grace for games with ♥♥♥♥ weapons is boss fights, If you have good boss fights they can make or break a game, so what are this games boss fights like? Well first of there "boss fight" just one, singular and it sucks. Lets call it standard boss fight 26 alpha, large man runs at you, you dive roll to the side, shoot boss while he tries to remember where he left his keys, and if he remembered to turn the stove off. Now, on to the topic of collectables the reward for the players who explore your game world. This game follows what most action games leave laying around, that right ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ audio logs. This is not a reward you story is ♥♥♥♥ i dont need to know more about it. You know if i added up all the audio logs ive collected in my life i could make the worlds ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ radio drama. Also this game is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ pitiful as a challenge to be overcome I was playing on hard and i still only died twice because the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ retarded ai doesnt pay attention to you if you're a certain distance away. So you will make good friends with the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ sniper rifle. So all in all i cant recommend you buy this game its boring, repetitive and worst of all it was written by a bunch of baboons.
